title: Fix Eval Script & Analyze Reward Discrepancy
description:
1. Fix boolean check on tensor `done` in `eval_trained_policy.py` to avoid ambiguity.
2. Explain why evaluation reward (-1200) is much lower than training (-600) (likely due to robot not moving + high distance penalty).

title: Tune Reward Function: Add Progress Reward
description:
1. Add `progress_reward_scale` to config.
2. Re-enable progress reward calculation in env.
3. Increase `collision_penalty` to prevent suicide behavior (local optimum).
4. Balance distance penalty vs progress reward.

title: Normalize LaserScan Observation
description: Divide LaserScan data by 100.0 (max range) in `get_observation` to normalize inputs for the policy network, while keeping physical units for reward calculation.

title: Fix Initial Goal Marker Publication
description: The goal marker is not published/visible in the first episode. This is likely due to the ROS publisher not latching the message, causing late subscribers (like RViz) to miss the initial publication. The fix is to enable `latch=True` for the `goal_marker_pub` in `RobotAgent`.
